source.derivation: Change pack version to 1.1.5; remove controlHint from FormDefinition access.grant-a-role's fields reason and residency, whose fieldsMeta options are non-empty; republish that changed form under version 1.0.2 (not the already-pinned 1.0.1 that 1.1.1/1.1.3/1.1.4 carry, to avoid pack.form.pinned_tuple_conflict on install); because that form version bump changes the WorkflowDefinition access.privileged-grant-review's subjectFormRef and the ViewDefinition access.holders' grant-submit inputForm, republish those two under their own next versions too (1.0.2 and 1.0.4 respectively) for the same reason; and set access.holders' viewKind to the platform's canonical table kind (layout.table) directly, since ReleasedViewKindCompatibility only projects the retired views.entity-list/grid token for the specific, already-released (packKey, version) pairs it lists, and gives new/unknown pack versions no such compatibility treatment.
